metadata.title: A binary system in the S cluster close to the supermassive black hole Sagittarius A*

notes: No eligible stars. D9 is studied as an S-cluster binary orbiting Sgr A* and is found stable against tidal disruption, not as a Galactic unbound candidate (T:p1-b6, T:p2-b1, T:p8-b3, T:p9-b2). The mention of a possible ejected third companion becoming a hypervelocity star (T:p8-b3) is hypothetical and does not identify a star.
